# Reform Barbershop

> Modern local barber in Donegal Town, Co. Donegal, Ireland, with a traditional twist. Men's haircuts, skin fades, beard trims, kids' and senior cuts.

- Address: SuperValu Shopping Centre, 9 Newpark Road, Donegal Town, Co. Donegal, Ireland
- Phone: 087 780 1057 (call to book)
- Email: Reformbarbershop@hotmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 6:30pm, closed Sunday
- Parking: right outside the shopping centre
- Booking: mainly by appointment, walk-ins when there's space
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/reformbarbershopdonegaltown/

## Prices
- Gents haircut: €18
- Student haircut: €17
- Kids haircut: €16
- Senior haircut: €16
- Head shave: €16
- Haircut and beard: €24

## Areas served
Donegal Town, Mountcharles, Laghey, Ballintra, Lough Eske, Frosses, Inver, Killymard, Barnesmore
